action.description: Select one of this operation's supported actions. Mutating actions change durable state.

id.description: An existing returned item identifier for this operation.

query.description: Describe the current task and which earlier preferences, decisions, constraints or lessons would help. Use natural language, not database syntax.

session_id.description: An existing host session reference. Omit unless a session-specific operation requires it; verified host identity takes precedence.
